# dsh-media-reader

> A plugin that lets a DeepSeek Harness agent read local images, audio and video — including on a model
> route that cannot accept media at all. Commercial licence, $79 / KSh 10,000 per team, one time. Free for
> personal, non-commercial use.

## What to hand your agent

- The storefront's "Install it with your own agent" section generates a prompt tailored to the visitor's
  harness, runtime, model route and goal. It is generated on the visitor's device; nothing is uploaded.
- The bundle ships four skills written to be read by an agent: dsh-plugin-install-safety,
  dsh-skill-install, dsh-test-boot, product-motion-studio.

## Facts an agent can rely on

- Install is copy-restore, never `dsh plugin add` and never a package manager.
- Verification is a command, not a claim: `DSH_TEST_URL=<scratch-instance> ./smoke.sh` → `18/18 checks passed`.
- The bundle's sha256 is published beside it; `MANIFEST.json` lists every file with its own hash.
- Requirements: Node >=20, ffmpeg, python3 (faster-whisper for local transcription).
- Known defect: audio and video drops insert absolute artifact paths into the composer draft; image drops
  carry only the file name.
